derivation.rule: March 2022 outcomes may motivate this revision, but March is permanently consumed and cannot be rescored as untouched validation.

newFactor.name: monetization/capture of the bottleneck
newFactor.reason: A verified shortage is not automatically positive for the mapped producer. The company must be able to deliver into the shortage and retain economic benefit.

newPenalty.name: reversal risk
newPenalty.reason: Contemporaneous evidence of falling spot prices, inventory accumulation or demand destruction must be considered before a cyclical shortage is treated as an upside signal.
